environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate in an isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway attached to subnet route table). Accessible exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with a VPC endpoint policy restricting Principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalServiceRole and Condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4. The endpoint's associated security group (sg-0fedcba987654321) permits inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.0.48.0/22 (internal service mesh sidecar range). DNS resolution for the service hostname resolves only within the VPC via Route 53 private hosted zone (no public DNS record exists). Additionally, the VPC has no internet gateway or virtual private gateway attached, and the subnet route table contains only local VPC routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry.

config.dns: Route 53 private hosted zone only, no public record
